_comment: TBD allowlist/forbidden patterns for TEST-PREP profiles. scenario_intent (v3 default): docs/test-prep-scenario-intent-contract.json. Legacy crtqa_outline below.

tbd_allowlist.note: No session literals in actions — use plain English; formulas in results with formula_provenance

tbd_forbidden_patterns.message: Bare [TBD] forbidden; use plain English intent or [oracle:TBD] in results only
[attach:TBD] is crtqa_outline only; scenario_intent has no attach steps
Angle-bracket session literals forbidden in scenario_intent actions

expansion_policy.one_bundle_per_scenario_group: Each scenario_groups[] row → one test_bundles[] entry; variant_sequence → one intent step per check variant

tbd_allowlist.pattern_note: Angle-bracket placeholders and tagged gaps are human-fill; agent must not invent real session ids.

tbd_forbidden_patterns.message: Whole-scenario ladder deferral forbidden in crtqa_outline.
Use case_outline rows instead of deferring sequences.
Expand case_outline; do not defer to coverage subsection only.

rules: One top-level numbered Action and one numbered Result per case_outline[] row.
command_patterns[pattern_ref] lines are sub-steps inside that Action (bullets or indented lines), not separate numbered pairs.
Results summarize observable metrics for the row; use [oracle:TBD] for deferred numerics or cite oracle rule enum when topology loaded.
single_pair_per_case_outline_row.anti_pattern: Do not emit N numbered Action/Result pairs for N lines in command_patterns[pattern_ref].

ladder_step: execution trade orderkey=<orderkey> orderstatus=COMPLETED price=<price> qty=<qty> transactiontime=now
command_patterns.ladder_step_note: Literary template in Actions only; agent must not execute during PREP.

watchlist_tier_by_qty: Observe Watchlist bid/ask for default order qty; compare to TextConfiguration tier closest >= qty
position_first_tier_quote: Observe Position Book bid/ask from first tier Quote stream only
console_show_prices_first_tier: verify bid/ask from first TextConfiguration tier
midpoint_invariant_observe: Compare midpoint across account groups on mark column surfaces
mark_from_midpoint_observe: Verify mark column equals midpoint for FX_SPOT on configured surfaces
